34' Fares Chaibi (Algeria) takes a short corner kick.

The scoreline remains the same. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Algeria will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

28' Fares Chaibi (Algeria) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Good work from Algeria as they win a corner.

23' Ali Olwan (Jordan) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Luca Zidane easily deals with the threat.
21' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Fares Chaibi (Algeria). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
19' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Algeria) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Yazeed Abulaila intercepts the ball.
17' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Algeria) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
16' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Algeria) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
13' A pass by Nizar Al Rashdan (Jordan) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is out of play. Algeria will have a throw-in.
